params.1273: Build your house so that it has 14 rooms.
params.1274: Talk to an estate agent to buy a house, if you have not already.
params.1275: Enter your house portal in build mode.
params.1276: Right-click any white transparent door and select a new room to build.
params.1277: At level 45 you can build a new chapel, where you can build altars and train your prayer skill!
